requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D.

User wants the property located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). Set at the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, since 'near' expresses a strong proximity need.
The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a direct total-surface threshold.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 1600 sqm), a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine_km on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1 through D, and healthcare proximity score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the specified coordinates, nearest first. No property-type filter was applied because none was in the extracted requirements.
